attempts.text:
**The window starts in a five-gene spine.** Columns 0 to 4, `cyuP`, `cyuA`, `yhaL`, `yhaK` and `yhaJ`, are carried by 96 to 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 0 to 0.2% of calls. The model names 99 to 99.6% of them, hesitating most at `cyuP` with 0.26 bits.

**A single variable column follows.** Column 5 is variable, in a region of plasticity in 0.2% of calls, and the model names only 15% there, with 0.08 bits. Then columns 6 to 26 form a 21-column spine, carried by 95 to 97% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 21% of calls; the model names 81 to 99.8%, fewest at `exuT`, 81%, its 0.61 bits the most hesitant of the stretch.

**Two variable columns, then a 12-column spine.** Columns 27 and 28 are variable, in a region of plasticity in 3% of calls, named 92%. Columns 29 to 40 are spine, carried by 90 to 97% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0.4 to 5% of calls, named 92 to 99%, fewest at `ygjJ`, 92%.

**The long fork and variable stretch runs from column 41 to 79**, in a region of plasticity in 10 to 50% of calls, named 77 to 96%. At column 41 a fork carries `mug` in 89% and an Arm DNA-binding family in 11%; columns 42 to 55 are variable, carried by 85 to 89%, including `rpoD`, `dnaG` and `rpsU`; forks at columns 56, 63, 65, 66, 69, 70, 71 and 79 carry second families beside the most carried ones. A branch of 3 families, `dsbI` to an aryl-sulfate sulfotransferase, runs through columns 69 to 71, carried by 19%. The model hesitates most at column 65, 0.85 bits, named 77%.

**The model names readily where the graph is persistent**, 98% of calls at 0.12 bits, and hesitates in the variable and fork columns: inside a region of plasticity it names 65% at 1.57 bits, against 96% at 0.14 bits outside. Across the window it names 93% of genes at 0.29 bits.

label: cyuP
facts:
WINDOW: the cyuP window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor cyuP, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 591 to 670 from dnaA. Read in 522 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying cyuP once); 41,760 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.29 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 34,437 calls, named 98%, 0.12 bits; shell 6,878 calls, named 69%, 0.93 bits; cloud 445 calls, named 35%, 3.61 bits. Outside an RGP 37,386 calls, named 96%, 0.14 bits; inside an RGP 4,374 calls, named 65%, 1.57 bits. Columns: 38 spine, 9 fork, 33 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.57 against 0.14 bits) and names fewer genes (65% against 96%); 4,374 of the 41,760 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 65 ("FimD/PapC C-terminal domain-containing…") 0.85 bits, RGP 49%; column 63 (yqiI) 0.79 bits, RGP 46%; column 64 (yqiH) 0.76 bits, RGP 50%. The 1 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 80%, 0.76 bits on average; the other 79 columns: named 93%, 0.28 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 41-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 10-50%; the least: columns 0-4 (spine), RGP 0-0.2%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-4 (5 columns) spine: share 96-100%, all P, RGP 0-0.2%. Genes: cyuP, cyuA "serine dehydratase subunit alpha fa…", yhaL "protein YhaL", yhaK "pirin family protein", yhaJ "LysR family transcriptional regulat…". named 99-99.6% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 2 (yhaL), named 99%; most hesitant at column 0 (cyuP), 0.26 bits.
2. column 5 variable: RGP 0.2%. named 15%; 0.08 bits.
   5: yhaI S 81% "DUF805 domain-containing protein"
3. columns 6-26 (21 columns) spine: share 95-97%, all P, RGP 0.2-21%. Genes: yhaH "DUF805 domain-containing protein", yqjG "glutathionyl-hydroquinone reductase…", yqjF "DoxX family protein", yqjK "YqjK-like family protein", yqjE "phage holin family protein", yqjD "YqjD family protein", yqjC "DUF1090 family protein YqjC", mzrA, yqjA "DedA family general envelope mainte…", yqiM "protein YqiM", exuR, exuT "MFS transporter", uxaC "glucuronate isomerase", uxaA, ygjV "YgjV family protein", sstT, alx, ygjR "Gfo/Idh/MocA family protein", ygjQ "vancomycin high temperature exclusi…", ygjP "M48 family metallopeptidase", rlmG. named 81-99.8% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 17 (exuT), named 81%, 0.61 bits.
4. columns 27-28 (2 columns) variable: RGP 3%. named 92%; most hesitant at column 27, 0.38 bits.
   27: higB S 60% "type II toxin-antitoxin system toxi…"
   28: higA S 80%
5. columns 29-40 (12 columns) spine: share 90-97%, all P, RGP 0.4-5%. Genes: fadH, ygjK "MGH1-like glycoside hydrolase domai…", ygjJ "protein YgjJ", ygjI "amino acid permease", ebgC "beta-galactosidase subunit beta", ebgA, ebgR, ygjH "tRNA-binding protein", ygjG "aminotransferase class III-fold pyr…", aer, nfeR, nfeF. named 92-99% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 31 (ygjJ), named 92%, 0.39 bits.
6. columns 41-79 (39 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 10-50%. named 77-96% (mean 91%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 65, named 77%, 0.85 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 69-71, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 19%, all S; the branch's families: dsbI, "DsbA family protein", "aryl-sulfate sulfotransferase"
   41 fork: mug P 89%; also "Arm DNA-binding domain-containing prote…" S 11%
   columns 42-55 variable, share 85-89%, all P: rpoD 89%, dnaG 89%, rpsU 89%, tsaD 89%, ttdT 86%, ttdB "L(+)-tartrate dehydratase subunit b…" 87%, ttdA 86%, ttdR 85%, plsY 87%, folB 87%, bacA 87%, cca 87%, ygiM "TIGR04211 family SH3 domain-contain…" 87%, ygiF "inorganic triphosphatase" 86%
   56 fork: glnE P 86%; also "DDE-type integrase/transposase/recombin…" S 13%
   columns 57-62 variable, share 48-86%, 4 P, 2 S: hldE 86%, ibsE "type I toxin-antitoxin system Ibs f…" 48%, ibsE 76%, yqiK "flotillin family protein" 82%, yqiJ "OB-fold-containig protein" 83%, glgS 85%
   63 fork: yqiI S 46%; also "fimbrial biogenesis chaperone" S 10%
   64 variable: yqiH S 43% "fimbrial biogenesis chaperone"
   65 fork: "FimD/PapC C-terminal domain-containing…" S 40%; also "fimbrial-like protein" S 10%
   66 fork: ygiL S 50% "fimbrial-like protein"; also "hypothetical protein" S 10%
   67 variable: ubiK P 84%
   68 variable: ribB P 84%
   69 fork: yqiD S 74% "protein YqiD"
   70 fork: zupT P 83%
   71 fork: ygiD P 83% "4,5-DOPA dioxygenase extradiol"
   columns 72-78 variable, share 70-83%, all P: ygiC "glutathionylspermidine synthase fam…" 83%, ygiB "DUF1190 family protein" 83%, tolC 83%, nudF 81%, yqiB "DUF1249 family protein" 78%, cpdA 74%, yqiA "esterase YqiA" 70%
   79 fork: parE P 60%; also ygiN P 27%, mdaB P 12%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): uxaA altronate dehydratase; higB type II toxin-antitoxin system toxin Hi…; higA type II toxin-antitoxin system antitoxi…; ebgA beta-galactosidase domain 4-containing…; ttdT anion permease; ttdR LysR substrate-binding domain-containin…; dsbI disulfide bond formation protein B; ygiN putative quinol monooxygenase; mdaB NADPH:quinone oxidoreductase MdaB
END: the window ends at column 79, parE, in 60% of chromosomes.
